quotes.text: So let me put it simply. Dataverse does not store your data differently. It forces your business to behave differently.

takeaways: Excel and SharePoint lists are cheap to start but shift cost into coordination, duplication and rework once a process grows across teams.
Dataverse enforces relationships, data types, security roles and audit history, giving apps, automation and AI one governed source of truth.
Before scaling, leaders must decide data model ownership, environment strategy, access model and ALM, then adopt Dataverse where structural pain is already visible.
hook: Power Apps built on Excel and SharePoint lists launch fast, then quietly fail on duplicates, delegation limits and access workarounds. This episode is for Power Platform makers, architects and IT leaders deciding on a data foundation, and it explains why Dataverse is an operating model decision that keeps apps, automation and Copilot trustworthy at scale.
